summary: AerSale Corp filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting completion of its redomestication from Delaware to Texas, effected via a plan of conversion approved by a majority of stockholders at the June 11, 2026 annual meeting. Each outstanding Delaware share converted one-for-one into Texas common stock, and all equity awards continued. New Texas charter and bylaws replaced Delaware governance documents. No change in business, management, assets, or liabilities. Not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor named. Watch for any future strategic actions under Texas law.
